title: Summable Mersenne-gap mass and explicit geometric tails

concepts.label: two-scale pointwise gap envelope
concepts.note: The explicit one-sided 4-adic and 8-adic upper envelope.

concepts.label: shifted Mersenne-gap series
concepts.note: The scalar gap sequence strictly above a cutoff.

concepts.label: remaining gap-mass budget
concepts.note: The explicit geometric upper bound for the shifted gap sum.

concepts.label: analytic-only boundary
concepts.note: Summed gap lengths do not encode which gaps the greedy orbit visits.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every positive n, mersenneGap n ≤ (2/3)*4^(-n)+3*8^(-n).
statement_nodes.engine: upper half of the previously proved two-channel Mersenne-gap estimate
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Pure geometric specialization of the existing per-level Mersenne-gap estimate; no new arithmetic input or novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is only a one-sided upper bound for n>0, not an equality or a sharp asymptotic constant.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every cutoff N, the nonnegative sequence k ↦ mersenneGap(N+k+1) is summable.
statement_nodes.engine: nonnegative domination by shifted 4-adic and 8-adic geometric envelopes
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Pure geometric summation of the existing per-level estimate; no new arithmetic input or novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Scalar summability says nothing about which gaps are encountered by the greedy orbit and supplies no achievement-set membership or nonmembership result.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every N, the infinite sum over k≥0 of mersenneGap(N+k+1) is at most (2/9)*4^(-N)+(3/7)*8^(-N). The summed indices are strictly beyond level N.
statement_nodes.engine: summability, termwise comparison, and exact summation of the two geometric envelopes
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Pure geometric summation of the existing per-level estimate; no new arithmetic input or novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem gives an upper envelope, not a matching lower bound or the asymptotic equivalence (2/9)*4^(-N). It is not a measure, covering, Borel–Cantelli, category, or probabilistic theorem.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: As N tends to infinity, the shifted total gap mass ∑ k, mersenneGap(N+k+1) tends to zero.
statement_nodes.engine: squeeze between zero and the two explicit geometric terms
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Pure geometric convergence of the explicit tail budget; no new arithmetic input or novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This deterministic analytic budget is not a cofinal producer, certifies no real such as 1/2, and does not settle Erdős #257.

intra_zone_relations.basis: Nonnegativity and domination by the two shifted geometric envelopes prove summability for every cutoff.
Summability licenses termwise comparison and splitting of the two geometric envelope sums.
Summing the pointwise 4-adic and 8-adic terms produces the constants 2/9 and 3/7.
The nonnegative gap tail is squeezed between zero and two geometric terms tending to zero.
